name: parallel agents + aggregator
description: Two agents answer the same problem in parallel and an aggregator picks between them. The redundancy is architectural only: both agents run the same model snapshot, so the shared-snapshot common-cause event is an order-1 cut set for the wrong-answer hazard.
provenance: Approach 2 of the Kaggle notebook 'HiP-HOPS for Agentic AI' (kooaslansefat), recorded as a graph specification so the example runs without langgraph.
